parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Service Mesh (ASM) instance is located.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: A list of Service Mesh instance IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: A required parameter. The value must be `servicemesh`.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: A list of tags. It can contain up to 20 items.
